task: Create one inert fixture to exercise canonical parent closure and exact main CI without changing application behavior.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: The merged post-merge CI hardening has exact-head unit regressions, but no new real GitHub-bot parent merge has yet exercised dispatch, correlated run proof and durable parent closure together.
observableOutcomes: Plan Before Code authorizes one new inert JSON fixture, one pre-existing release-execution regression test file and canonical development metadata without changing product runtime.
The trusted executor creates and closes one real child transaction against its exact materialized commit, without changing existing parent evidence.
A new bot-authored parent closure PR merges into main and persists POST_MERGE_CI_PENDING instead of prematurely closing the parent.
One uniquely correlated GitHub-bot workflow_dispatch CI runs against the exact merged main SHA, with binding, quality, TypeScript, build and security-audit jobs succeeding.
The new canonical parent state records the correlated successful CI run ID and transitions to MERGED / PARENT_CLOSED only after verified terminal success.
unresolvedRisks: GitHub may accept a dispatch but delay making the run visible, so the persisted DISPATCH_ARMED reservation must not authorize a blind retry.
An unrelated main merge during the rehearsal can invalidate the exact main lease and must block rather than reuse another CI.
CI duration or the separate legacy queued #182 anomaly must not be mistaken for live proof of this new transaction.
Any guard or proof semantic disagreement blocks the new run without modifying the already closed predecessor release state.
The original V1 child remains STALE and must not be replayed into V2; every V2 child and parent proof must reference only its own new source SHA.

in: One inert JSON fixture under a new dedicated quality/knowledge/rehearsal-fixtures/post-merge-exact-main-ci-v2 directory.
One development plan metadata update on an isolated source branch; no edits to application runtime, scripts, workflow or tests.
One targeted regression assertion in the existing release-unit execution-binding test; this supplies the critical plan's explicit MUST_EDIT and PROOF routes without adding a new engine.
Use only the existing canonical release-unit executor, source CI, child proof, parent PR, CAS persistence and post-merge dispatch implementation.
Verify actual GitHub parent PR merge identity, nonce-bound workflow_dispatch run metadata, mandatory successful jobs and durable parent closure.
out: No modification of DEV-CONTROL-PLANE-MULTI-UNIT-REHEARSAL-V1 state, U01/U02/U03 receipts, or immutable source 65e52ffd1fd32f14353467eb7c52b2e06ba1be65.
No production behavior, database schema, storefront, Builder, template, customer or payment changes.
No manually fabricated release-state receipts, no forced closure, no bypass of Plan, Truth, Lifecycle or CI authority.
No duplicate dispatch in the case of uncertain delivery; fail closed pending human review.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: This proof drives real repository branch, pull-request, CI, merge and persisted orchestration state while deliberately restricting material changes to non-product fixtures. Exact identity, fail-closed transitions and final closure therefore require the strongest practical bounded assurance.

acceptanceCriteria: Plan Before Code independently authorizes one inert fixture and one focused existing test update before either implementation edit, and source admission CI succeeds at the immutable exact head.
Canonical decomposition contains exactly one authorized JSON fixture child with a valid source blob, and only its intended file is merged into main.
A new parent PR is merged by github-actions[bot] with a trusted exact-head proof and parent state remains POST_MERGE_CI_PENDING until a separate main CI is proven.
One source/parent/merged-main nonce is bound to the new workflow_dispatch CI, not an unrelated push or manual workflow event.

Terminal SUCCESS of the exact main head run includes Bind exact parent post-merge main CI, Knowledge preflight, Incremental Replay, Quality tests, TypeScript check, Production build and security-audit.
Persisted parent closure is MERGED / PARENT_CLOSED only after CI proof; all three older closed units and original parent proof remain unmodified.
invariants: New source transaction and stateRef are distinct from DEV-CONTROL-PLANE-MULTI-UNIT-REHEARSAL-V1.
Exactly one inert fixture and one existing regression test file are the only material source edits, with no product runtime changes.
Exact run identity requires GitHub-bot actor, workflow_dispatch, unique nonce, parent source, workflow identity and mergedMainSha.
DISPATCH_ARMED is persisted by CAS before any side effect, and uncertain recovery cannot dispatch the same request again.
No parent completion claim without a successful exact-head GitHub run and all mandatory job steps.
forbiddenStates: Old U01/U02/U03 state or proof artifact is overwritten or reclassified.
Fixture or test implementation edit is created before the source plan gate proves PASS.
Parent is marked MERGED immediately after bot PR merge while main CI remains absent.
A manual push or unrelated successful main CI is accepted as the correlated post-merge dispatch.
Two requests with the same parent nonce are sent after crash or delayed run visibility.
Changed main SHA, wrong actor, missing security/build evidence or nonterminal CI closes the parent.

failureModes: Plan scope or Known Failure projection drifts after new inert fixture declaration.
Materialized fixture source blob is absent or mismatched on the immutable source commit.
Child CI finishes without matching lifecycle proof, preventing child merge.
Parent merge succeeds but persisted pending state or dispatch CAS experiences an interruption.
GitHub dispatch request succeeds but the run ID is not immediately visible.
Another GitHub event or main merge introduces a stale head before post-merge proof.
Correlated CI fails, is cancelled, or lacks mandatory job evidence.
edgeCases: A single child follows the canonical decomposition and no child predecessor reconciliation is necessary.
A `workflow_run` hook from a successful source push launches the trusted default-branch executor.
GitHub bot-triggered merge does not create automatic main push CI, requiring explicit workflow_dispatch.
The dispatch response is lost after the server accepts the request, leaving a durable DISPATCH_ARMED reservation.
The valid run becomes visible on a later poll without repeating the dispatch.
The CI run is terminal SUCCESS but unrelated actor or run title must be rejected.

alternatives.summary: Use one inert fixture through the unchanged real GitHub executor.
alternatives.reason: This is the smallest safe material scope that actually reaches child merge, parent merge, bot dispatch and parent close.

alternatives.summary: Trust the already-green mock regression without a live GitHub rehearsal.
alternatives.reason: A mock cannot independently demonstrate real workflow_run admission, GitHub actor identity or remote CAS evidence.

alternatives.summary: Repeat the old multi-unit corpus with twenty-five files.
alternatives.reason: The earlier rehearsal already proved child orchestration; repeating it adds CI and merge exposure unrelated to the missing post-merge edge.

specialistReviews.finding: The unproven scope is the live post-merge parent CI chain, not the existing multi-child orchestration.
specialistReviews.resolution: Use exactly one independent inert fixture through the canonical executor without new control paths.

specialistReviews.finding: Even an inert live rehearsal writes a branch, merges a PR and can dispatch GitHub Actions unexpectedly.
specialistReviews.resolution: Isolate new parent identity, keep all original release-state immutable, require strict Plan Before Code and fail-closed CAS/dispatch handling.

specialistReviews.finding: An ordinary successful push CI cannot prove the new workflow_dispatch parent binding.
specialistReviews.resolution: Require a distinct bot-actor workflow_dispatch main CI with the exact nonce, SHA, run ID and mandatory successful jobs.

specialistReviews.finding: Unknown plan semantics or a missing source fixture must not be reinterpreted as success.
specialistReviews.resolution: Stop on every canonical failed gate and use Failure Intake for unexpected blockers.

challenge.scenario: The new source is admitted without a successful Plan Before Code proof.
challenge.finding: An inert fixture alone does not exempt source transactions from governed authorization.
challenge.resolution: Validate the plan on an isolated plan branch before creating the fixture on the execution source branch.

challenge.scenario: The parent squash merge succeeds, but no ordinary main push CI appears.
challenge.finding: The missing GitHub GITHUB_TOKEN edge remains unproven by push-based checks.
challenge.resolution: Require a separate nonce-correlated workflow_dispatch run bound to exact mergedMainSha.

challenge.scenario: Workflow dispatch succeeds and the executor crashes before receiving or persisting run ID.
challenge.finding: Blind retry can create two indistinguishable dispatch attempts.
challenge.resolution: Require durable one-shot DISPATCH_ARMED and lookup only; uncertain recovery remains blocked without new dispatch.

challenge.scenario: A coincidental manual or push main CI succeeds on the same merged commit.
challenge.finding: Head SHA alone is insufficient evidence for the required bot dispatch path.
challenge.resolution: Verify bot actor, workflow, event, nonce, source parent and exact required successful steps.

challenge.scenario: An older legacy Release Unit Execution run remains queued.
challenge.finding: Its status is unrelated to proof for the new parent transaction.
challenge.resolution: Do not mutate or reuse #182; select only source-bound execution and correlated post-merge runs.

challenge.scenario: A normal CI push runs on the newly merged main commit and reports SUCCESS before the parent dispatch appears.
challenge.finding: The unrelated push lacks nonce and the bot workflow_dispatch identity, so it could falsely satisfy a loose exact-SHA-only proof.
challenge.resolution: Require an independent workflow_dispatch event with the deterministic parent nonce, accepted actor and recorded run ID; never reuse a push run.

challenge.scenario: The correlated main CI finishes with a successful workflow conclusion, but the security-audit or exact-parent-binding job step is absent.
challenge.finding: A green workflow summary alone does not show that the mandatory job-level proof actually executed.
challenge.resolution: Inspect the exact run jobs and every required binding, quality, typecheck, production build and security step before persisting PARENT_CLOSED.

challenge.scenario: An interrupted source executor restarts from a prior committed one-fixture child branch after another release changed main.
challenge.finding: A prior successful child proof cannot authorize materialization or parent closure against a different current main.
challenge.resolution: Enforce exact main lease with canonical source/PR/CAS identity, and stop on drift rather than creating another untracked branch.

challenge.scenario: The new child binder correctly adds release-unit lexical intent but the parent still has a neutral quality-fixture task.
challenge.finding: Before PR #1172 the projection inherited neutral parent scope, causing the prior child's Negative Knowledge and guard digest to drift.
challenge.resolution: Exercise the merged shared child-task authority in a freshly generated V2 child plan, rejecting any scope, negative-knowledge or digest disagreement.

proofPlan: Verify Plan Before Code PASS for this plan-only transaction before writing the one fixture or the new targeted test assertion.
Create the one inert JSON source fixture only on a dedicated release-execution/source/* branch after plan authorization.
Verify source exact-head CI is SUCCESS and inspect the admitted trusted Release Unit Execution run.
Verify the one child has exact source blob, materialized PR, completed gates and merged-main receipt.
Verify parent PR exact-head proof, trusted bot merge and persisted POST_MERGE_CI_PENDING state.
Verify a separately dispatched GitHub-bot CI with exact nonce, merged SHA, terminal SUCCESS and all required successful job steps.
Verify persisted MERGED / PARENT_CLOSED proof, final main identity and unchanged earlier parent state; otherwise stop as BLOCKED.

requirements.requirement: The new one-file inert source must be authorized and materially bounded by the canonical plan without modifying product runtime.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: No fixture outside the one-file scope or unauthenticated source operation may be accepted.

requirements.requirement: The rehearsal must preserve canonical release risk and reject unauthorized material changes or foreign state mutation.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: A blocked risk gate or stale source cannot be treated as executable.

requirements.requirement: Parent execution must never close before a uniquely correlated bot-dispatched exact-merged-head main CI succeeds with all required job evidence.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Pending, missing, failed or unrelated main CI cannot be treated as PARENT_CLOSED.

notes: Isolated V2 plan-only checkpoint after successful PR #1172 merge and exact-merged-main CI #9292. Preserve original CLOSED multi-unit parent and all U01/U02/U03 proofs; preserve failed DEV-POST-MERGE-EXACT-MAIN-CI-E2E-V1 state as STALE without edits. First run Plan Before Code on this exact plan-only HEAD before creating a fixture or release-execution/source branch. This V2 uses one inert JSON fixture plus one targeted existing regression-test assertion; only existing canonical executor, child/parent merge, one-shot bot workflow_dispatch and nonce-bound exact-head main CI may complete parent closure. Executor-derived parent closure proof plan. Historical implementation remains authoritative through CLOSED child receipts and trusted-main evidence; this plan scopes only lifecycle metadata closure.
